children: RNS Number : 4466A  Abu Dhabi National Energy Co PJSC  26 October 2026
Abu Dhabi National Energy Company PJSC
Admission of Notes to Trading
The following notes issued by Abu Dhabi National Energy Company PJSC (the Issuer) have today (26 October 2026) been admitted to trading on the main market of the London Stock Exchange plc:
1.       U.S.$1,100,000,000 5.875 per cent. Green Notes due 2032 (Reg S ISIN: XS3548884595/ Rule 144A ISIN: US00388WBG50) (the 2032 Notes)
2.       U.S.$650,000,000 6.125 per cent. Notes due 2036 (Reg S ISIN: XS3550564739/ Rule 144A ISIN: US00388WBJ99) (the 2036 Notes and together with the 2032 Notes, the Notes)

The Notes are issued under the Issuer's U.S.$20,000,000,000 Global Medium Term Note Programme (the Programme) pursuant to the base prospectus dated 1 May 2026, as supplemented by the supplements dated 6 July 2026 and 15 September 2026 (together, the Base Prospectus), read together with the Final Terms for the 2032 Notes and the Final Terms for the 2036 Notes, each dated 22 October 2026. Full information on the Issuer and the offer of the Notes is only available on the basis of the Base Prospectus, read together with the relevant Final Terms.

The Base Prospectus (including the supplements mentioned above) and the Final Terms have been published on the website of the London Stock Exchange through a regulatory information service (http://www.londonstockexchange.com/exchange/news/market-news/market-news-home.html).
For further information, please contact ir@taqa.com and treasury@taqa.com
